sample: First ten directly U.S.-listed U.S. parent companies in NYFed 2023Q4 table, PDF p38; exclude unlisted foreign subsidiary TD Group US Holdings LLC. Includes investment banks; not all banks or savings holding companies.
pe_definition: Entry price / originally published FY2023 GAAP diluted EPS; not TTM
broad_buying: At least 3 of 5 managers increase common-share quantity. Absent common row in a complete filing = zero; no missing filing treated as zero.
aggregate: Change in sum of these five reported positions, not ownership percentage or market-wide net flow.
sensitivity_managers: Leave one manager out; strict majority of remaining four = 3
sensitivity_material_change: Reclassify increases only if >1% instead of >0%
status: Exploratory retrospective case. Universe and managers fixed before inspecting expanded-sample outcomes; not a preregistered backtest. Do not assume previous single-manager conclusion holds.
boundary_diagnostic: 20.01 was added after observing the unrounded MS multiple of 20.0019; the primary rule remains 20. This is a disclosed boundary diagnostic, not a selected return-maximizing cutoff.
